entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return my VeloBand GPS Tracker. It's defective.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
The pulse tracker is garbage. It's completely inaccurate. Look, I don't have time for a big back-and-forth. I just want my money back.
I understand your frustration. Sometimes a quick reset can solve sensor inaccuracies. Would you be open to trying just one troubleshooting step with me?
No. I'm busy and I don't have time to be your tech support. The product doesn't work as advertised. I want a refund, period.
Okay, I hear you. No problem. Let me just pull up your account to check the return eligibility. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Thank you, Sam. One moment... Okay, I see your order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered on January 2nd, which was 17 days ago.
And? Are you going to give me a refund or not?
Yes, absolutely. According to my system, our policy allows for returns up to 10 days after delivery. You are unfortunately outside that timeframe. I've just initiated the return process for you.
Oh. Okay, great. That was easy enough. What's next?

I've just sent a return shipping label to your email on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box with the VeloBand inside, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
You're very welcome, Sam. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
